evals.prompt: This repository has components.json. Review a date parser inside a domain module; no UI, registry, primitive, preset, or shadcn command is involved.
evals.expected_output: A non-trigger decision that keeps the shadcn skill and all of its references out of context.
expectations: Does not trigger shadcn from components.json alone
Does not run shadcn info, docs, search, view, dry-run, or diff
Routes the task to its actual repository owner
Does not load shadcn composition, forms, styling, icon, registry, CLI, or MCP references

evals.prompt: The official shadcn Button is already installed. Review a behavior-neutral local usage cleanup; no registry lookup, package change, or visual redesign is needed.
evals.expected_output: A local-source short-circuit that returns the installed primitive to the ordinary frontend workflow.
expectations: Inspects the installed Button and direct consumer first
Does not refresh shadcn info or inspect a registry without evidence
Loads only frontend topic rules triggered by the local diff
Does not load generated-ui-validation merely because Button originated from shadcn
Does not load supply-chain, integration, security, design, MCP, or testing workflows without evidence

evals.prompt: This project needs the official shadcn Tooltip primitive, but it may not be installed. Gather the exact impact for an implementation plan without changing repository files.
evals.expected_output: An inspect-only path that checks local availability and previews exact impact without mutation.
expectations: Checks the resolved local UI path before assuming Tooltip is absent
Uses the lockfile-resolved project CLI instead of switching to @latest
Uses version-appropriate docs and add --dry-run with targeted diff
Reports previewed files, dependencies, CSS, assets, runtime surfaces, and unknowns
Does not run add without --dry-run or install a dependency

evals.prompt: The developer approved adding the official shadcn Separator after a dry-run showed one component file and no new dependency or global CSS. Apply the approved change.
evals.expected_output: A narrow mutation transaction that re-previews, rejects drift, applies only the approved delta, and returns changed-file evidence.
expectations: Reruns the same preview before mutation
Stops if files, dependencies, or runtime impact drift from approval
Applies only the approved component and does not use implicit overwrite
Confirms the applied files and dependencies match the approved preview
Routes only concrete diff evidence to relevant frontend topic rules
Does not load generated-ui-validation solely because the CLI generated a file

evals.prompt: A dry-run for an official @shadcn chart primitive shows that it will add a new npm package and global CSS. The primitive is official, so can the agent apply it immediately?
evals.expected_output: A stop-and-handoff decision because official registry identity does not waive dependency or runtime gates.
expectations: Does not treat official @shadcn provenance as dependency approval
Routes the package evidence to audit-frontend-supply-chain
Routes global CSS or feature runtime evidence to the owning integration gate
Does not rerun boundary design when approved analysis already places official shadcn primitives in src/components/ui and no evidence changes ownership
Requires approval before mutation
Requires a fresh preview and drift check after approval

evals.prompt: Inspect the community shadcn registry item acme/ui/login-panel and tell me exactly what it would add. Do not install or copy anything yet.
evals.expected_output: An inspect-only result that identifies the exact external artifact and hands it to supply-chain review without adoption.
expectations: Uses search/view and project-context dry-run rather than add, install, or copy
Preserves the exact registry address and version or resolved commit evidence
Records generated files, dependencies, CSS, assets, runtime surfaces, and unknowns
Routes the exact artifact to audit-frontend-supply-chain before adoption approval
Does not treat inspection or an audit recommendation as mutation authority

evals.prompt: Supply-chain review and the developer approved exact community item acme/ui/login-panel@abc123. Install only that reviewed artifact.
evals.expected_output: A post-audit shadcn apply transaction constrained to the approved address and commit.
expectations: Resolves the exact approved address and commit instead of searching for an alternative
Reruns the preview and compares it with the approved evidence record
Stops on source, file, dependency, CSS, asset, or runtime drift
Applies only after all evidence-triggered gates are resolved
Verifies the exact applied delta and returns it to relevant frontend topic rules

evals.prompt: Update the installed shadcn Button, which has local project modifications. The developer has not approved overwriting those changes.
evals.expected_output: A safe update path that compares upstream with local source and refuses implicit overwrite.
expectations: Uses the CLI dry-run and targeted diff as the upstream comparison source
Identifies local modifications before applying an update
Does not use --overwrite or replace the customized file implicitly
Requests an explicit replacement decision or prepares a reviewed manual merge
Keeps the final mutation inside the approved upstream delta

evals.prompt: Apply a new shadcn preset to this existing project. Components, fonts, tokens, and globals.css may be replaced, and no overwrite strategy has been selected.
evals.expected_output: A preset gate that inspects both sides and waits for overwrite, partial, merge, or skip approval.
expectations: Treats the preset code as opaque and uses the lockfile-resolved CLI
Inspects current configuration, CSS, fonts, components, and local modifications
Previews incoming files, dependencies, and global changes
Requires an explicit overwrite, partial, merge, or skip decision
Does not mutate while that decision or an evidence-triggered gate is unresolved

evals.prompt: Implement a developer-approved design-provider screen. The design requires a Dialog that is not installed, so add the official shadcn primitive and complete the screen.
evals.expected_output: A composed route where shadcn handles only the Dialog transaction and design-provider validation remains owned by the parent UI task.
expectations: Runs the shadcn inspect, gate, apply, and transaction verification only for Dialog
Returns the generated delta to the parent implementation instead of treating shadcn as design authority
Uses project topic rules for placement, semantics, styling, and runtime decisions
Loads generated-ui-validation because the parent task uses an approved design-provider artifact
Does not duplicate the shadcn preview, dependency, drift, or overwrite checks inside generated UI validation

evals.prompt: Create and verify a private shadcn registry item definition for an already approved internal primitive. Do not install the item into the application.
evals.expected_output: A registry-authoring route that reads only registry schema/build mechanics and does not start an adoption flow.
expectations: Loads the task-routed registry authoring and build sections
Preserves the approved primitive ownership and does not redesign its API
Does not treat registry build success as application adoption approval
Does not run an add/install mutation against the application
Returns registry build and verification evidence

evals.prompt: Use the configured shadcn MCP to inspect an official registry item. Return its metadata only and do not install it.
evals.expected_output: An explicit MCP inspect-only route with the same source and mutation boundaries as the CLI.
expectations: Loads the MCP reference only because a configured shadcn MCP is explicitly requested
Uses search or view capability without install mutation
Preserves exact registry identity and returned metadata
Does not treat an MCP add-command result as mutation approval
Returns inspect-only evidence without loading unrelated composition references
